Data_Indication_functionality() Figure 9.19: Process ResponseOnEvent OnDtcChange Above sequence diagram shows processing of ResponseOnEvent service for subservice OnDtcChange. After configuration and activation of the event by the service ResponseOnEvent, the Dcm checks the status of the configured DTC on every call to interface Dcm_DemTriggerOnDTCStatus in order to identify if the event shall be trigger. This interface is Manager called by DEM for any DTC status change and independing of the activation/unactiva- tion of ResponseOnEvent.
